title: Efficient-score domination: exact gap and equality conditions
statement: Var(E[S_hat|q]) - S_psi^+(I_q) = (B*_full - B*_q) I^q_ll (B*_full - B*_q)^T exactly; equality for fixed q iff (B*_full - B*_q) I^q_ll = 0 (the full-data nuisance projection is binned-optimal); along partition sequences refining to the Borel sigma-field the gap vanishes. At global finite Ds optima the gap is the DS15 projection tax and vanishes almost surely for conditionally centered laws with d_psi = d_lambda = 1 (DS15 conclusion (v), audited); beyond that class it is OPEN-DS-MARGINS-NONCENTERED.
